title: Video walkthrough pages share the keyframe lane and finish selection cues
goal: Six video walkthroughs each carry their own identical copy of the animation timeline row, and a couple of steps claim something is selected without ever showing it. This moves the timeline row into the shared set and finishes the missing selection cues.
notes: From ux-audit rescan 2026-08-23 ('Video walkthroughs'). Pages: video-cut-wt, video-freeze-wt, video-move-wt, video-title-wt, video-transition-wt, video-zoom-wt. Promote the byte-identical .track.kft/.kfl/.kfd/.kfseg keyframe-lane CSS from move/zoom/cut into shared/components/video.css and delete page copies; video-title-wt add canvas sel-ring for the selected text layer in steps 5-6; add selwrap where .sel-ring is hosted bare; icon fixes (ic-speed for Speed, ic-trim for Shorten, chevron in .select caret, stop rotating ic-chevron-down in shared video.css .xbtn). Verify 200 + audit-sweep.
acceptance: The animation timeline row is defined once and shared, with no page keeping a copy
Every walkthrough step that says something is selected shows a selection on the canvas
Icons on those pages depict the action they trigger, and no icon spins where it should sit still
All six pages load without error and pass the automated page sweep
